name: Docker Build, Test, and Push
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      docker-image-name:
        required: true
        type: string
      docker-build-dir:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: .
      docker-build-timeout-minutes:
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 30
      docker-registry:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: docker.io
      push:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      force-push:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
    secrets:
      DOCKERHUB_USERNAME:
        required: true
      DOCKERHUB_TOKEN:
        required: true

jobs:
  build-test-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.docker-build-timeout-minutes }}
    outputs:
      docker-image: ${{ steps.output.outputs.docker-image }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        if: ${{ inputs.push }}
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Determine image tags
        id: tags
        env:
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          GITHUB_REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          GITHUB_REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          IMAGE=${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}
          REGISTRY=${{ inputs.docker-registry }}
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" == "tag" ]]; then
            TAG=${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
            TAG=${TAG#v}
            TAGS="${IMAGE}:${TAG},${IMAGE}:${TAG%%.*},${IMAGE}:${TAG%%.*.*},${IMAGE}:${GITHUB_SHA}"
          else
            TAGS="${IMAGE}:${GITHUB_SHA}"
          fi
          echo "tags=$TAGS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "image=${IMAGE}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build and test Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ inputs.docker-build-dir }}
          file: ${{ inputs.docker-build-dir }}/Dockerfile
          target: test
          tags: ${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}
          load: true
          push: false
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Build and push final image
        if: ${{ inputs.push }}
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ inputs.docker-build-dir }}
          file: ${{ inputs.docker-build-dir }}/Dockerfile
          target: production
          tags: ${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}
          push: true
          load: false
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Set output image
        id: output
        env:
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          IMAGE=${{ steps.tags.outputs.image }}
          echo "docker-image=${IMAGE}:${GITHUB_SHA}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
